title: Contract price governs
text: Where the invoice price exceeds the contract price in force on the order date, the customer may deduct the difference and a credit memo is issued.

title: Price disputes without variance
text: Where the invoice price matches the contract price, a pricing deduction is invalid and the amount is rebilled with the contract price evidence.

title: Trade promotion agreements
text: Promotion and trade allowance deductions are valid only against a signed promotion agreement and matched to the trade promotion accrual.

title: Proof of performance
text: Display, feature ad and scan-back allowances require proof of performance before the deduction is accepted.

title: Proof of delivery
text: Shortage deductions are accepted when the signed proof of delivery records fewer units received than invoiced.

title: Clean proof of delivery
text: A clean signed proof of delivery showing full quantity received makes a shortage deduction invalid.

title: Damage claim window
text: Damaged goods claims must be raised within 10 days of delivery with photo evidence of the damage.

title: Carrier recovery
text: Accepted damage credits are recovered from the carrier where the damage occurred in transit.

title: Retailer routing guide
text: Compliance chargebacks for late delivery, ASN errors or labeling are valid only where the supplier caused the violation under the retailer routing guide.

title: Carrier or retailer fault
text: Chargebacks caused by carrier delay or retailer appointment changes are disputed with the delivery appointment record.
